previous_notes.author: Dr. S. de Vries (GP)
previous_notes.text: Patient presented with a PSA of 4.3 ng/mL and a normal digital rectal examination. Initial multiparametric MRI was unremarkable. A systematic 12-core biopsy was performed, which showed no evidence of malignancy. The patient was advised to continue annual PSA monitoring.

pathology_report:
Biopsy 1 (Aug 2024): Microscopic examination of the prostate tissue cores reveals benign prostatic glands with no evidence of malignancy. The Gleason score is 0+0, corresponding to ISUP grade group 0. No cribriform or intraductal patterns are identified. Perineural invasion is absent.
Biopsy 2 (Feb 2025): Histological review of the recent systematic and targeted cores shows benign prostatic tissue without carcinoma. The Gleason score is reported as 0+0 and ISUP grade group 0. No high-risk architectural patterns such as cribriform or intraductal carcinoma are visualized. Perineural invasion is not seen.
